hero.title: Group Home Staffing Solutions In Canada
hero.subtitle:
Group homes staff shortage is a common challenge across Canada. This creates unnecessary pressure on existing staff.
At Goodwill Staffing, we understand how crucial it is for group homes to keep services consistent, safe, and efficient.
Our role is to supply qualified health professionals to group homes across Canada.

blocks.text: Why Group Homes Partner with Goodwill Staffing

blocks.html:
Staffing shortages can happen without a prior warning. A nurse calls in sick, a group home expands services, or seasonal demand increases patient volume.

These shifts leave group homes scrambling to maintain quality care. Traditional hiring is slow and costly, making it impossible to adapt quickly.

Goodwill Staffing provides a direct solution. We connect group homes with pre-screened healthcare professionals who are ready to fill roles immediately.

Instead of spending weeks on job postings, interviews, and credential checks, your group home gains access to staff who meet your requirements from day one.

We focus on three priorities:

Consistency – keeping group home operations running smoothly.

Quality – ensuring only trained and certified staff are supplied.

Speed – delivering the right professionals exactly when you need them.

blocks.text: Our Range of Staffing Solutions for Group Homes

blocks.html:
Every group home has unique needs, and our staffing model is built for flexibility. We provide you with staff for one shift, ongoing coverage, or specialized support. Whatever your needs are, our role is to tailor the specific solutions to them.

Nurses for Group Homes

Registered nurses and licensed practical nurses form the backbone of group home care. We provide nurses with experience in outpatient care, chronic disease management, health assessments, immunizations, and minor procedures.

They adapt quickly to group home workflows and support both physicians and patients with professionalism.

Personal Support Workers (PSWs)

Personal Support Workers play a vital role in patient comfort and care coordination. In group homes, they assist with patient flow, basic assessments, and administrative support.

Our PSWs are trained, reliable, and focused on keeping your patients at ease.

Allied Health Professionals

Group homes often require specialized staff to support diagnostics, rehabilitation, and treatment.

We supply physiotherapists, respiratory therapists, occupational therapists, lab technologists, and medical imaging specialists. 

These professionals expand your group home’s capacity to deliver comprehensive care.

Administrative and Support Staff

Smooth operations depend on more than group home care staff. 

We can also provide administrative workers, receptionists, and medical office assistants who keep scheduling, billing, and patient records organized.

Every group home has its own focus and population. Some provide care for seniors, others support adults with developmental disabilities, while others focus on mental health or transitional living. Goodwill Staffing tailors placements to the type of group home you manage.

  • Seniors’ Group Homes – nurses and PSWs with experience in dementia care, palliative support, and mobility assistance.
  • Developmental Disability Homes – caregivers trained in behavioral support, daily living assistance, and community integration.
  • Mental Health Residences – staff familiar with crisis management, medication support, and compassionate engagement.
  • Transitional Living Homes – professionals who can balance independence support with safety monitoring and guidance.

This targeted approach ensures the staff we place not only meet group home care requirements but also understand the emotional, social, and personal needs of your residents.

We know group homes cannot compromise on patient safety. That’s why every professional we place goes through a strict vetting process:

  • Credential Verification – degrees, licenses, and certifications are confirmed.
  • Background Checks – safety and compliance standards are met.
  • Experience Review – group home placements align with proven expertise.
  • Ongoing Training – staff keep skills updated to meet evolving healthcare standards.

This ensures when a Goodwill professional arrives at your group home, they give their all to make an impact in your facility and beyond.

blocks.text: Your Trusted Partner in Patient Focused Care

blocks.html:
Many group homes treat patients with complex conditions. Our staff bring experience in:

  • Dementia Care – staff trained to support patients with memory challenges.
  • Palliative Support – compassionate care for patients with life-limiting illnesses.
  • Mobility Assistance – professionals skilled in assisting patients with physical limitations.

By providing staff with these specialized skills, group homes can confidently deliver care that meets diverse patient needs.

We make staffing simple and efficient:

  1. Assessment – we review your group home’s specific staffing requirements.
  2. Matching – we select professionals from our vetted pool who fit your needs.
  3. Placement – staff are assigned quickly, often within hours.
  4. Support – we maintain communication to ensure ongoing satisfaction.

This streamlined process saves your group home time and ensures patient care is never interrupted.

• We specialize exclusively in healthcare staffing.
  • We understand the pressures group homes face daily.
  • We have a proven network of trained and reliable professionals.
  • We focus on building long-term relationships, not just filling shifts.

When you work with Goodwill, you get more than a staffing agency. You get a partner invested in your group home’s success.

items.title: We match you with qualified professionals

items.question: How fast can you provide staff for our group home?
items.answer: Most placements are filled within 24–72 hours. We prioritize urgent needs and communicate timeline estimates from the start.

items.question: Are your professionals trained in outpatient and group home protocols?
items.answer: Yes. Our team members have experience with community-based group homes, group homes, walk-ins, and outpatient workflows. They are trained in EMRs, patient flow efficiency, infection control, and documentation.

items.question: Can we hire someone permanently if they’re a good fit?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer both direct permanent placement services and contract-to-hire models so you can evaluate a candidate before extending a permanent offer.

items.question: Do you staff rural and remote group homes?
items.answer: Yes. We provide group homes staffing across Canada, including underserved and rural communities. Our mobile and travel staff are equipped to support hard-to-reach areas.
